description: This file defines the CategoryServices class containing static methods for handling category-related operations within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving category members, navigating between products, constructing category trees, and managing category data with database interactions.

classes.name: CategoryServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing product categories, including retrieval, navigation, and hierarchical tree construction within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCategoryMembers
methods.description: Retrieves the members of a specified product category, filtering by date and handling errors, returning category details and members.

methods.name: getPreviousNextProducts
methods.description: Obtains the previous and next product IDs within a category given a current product, supporting various filters and ordering.

methods.name: getCategoryFindEntityName
methods.description: Determines the appropriate entity name to query based on sorting fields and date limits, distinguishing between category member types.

methods.name: getProductCategoryAndLimitedMembers
methods.description: Fetches a product category along with a limited, optionally filtered list of member products, supporting view pagination and stock filtering.

methods.name: getChildCategoryTree
methods.description: Generates a hierarchical JSON structure representing child categories or catalogs for a given category ID, suitable for tree display components.
